verdict.rationale: The axis applies: ClickHouse Cloud ships agentic features such as the AI notebook agent, so letting users plug in external MCP servers is a plausible capability. However, nothing in the evidence shows ClickHouse acting as an MCP client. The MCP evidence covers only the official mcp-clickhouse server, which exposes ClickHouse to other assistants and is the server role, not this client-side story.
